description: Search EV charging stations by city, state, network, connector, speed, power or live availability. Returns station details including name, address, connector types, and pricing. Stations whose verified owner is on Listed Pro come first. Each station has verified_owner and owner_profile (the verified owner's hours, amenities, pricing, photos and contact link on a paid plan, else null).

available_now.description: Only stations showing a free port in a live reading under 15 minutes old. Live availability is commercially licensed: requires a paid API key.

connector.description: Connector type, case-insensitive: CCS, NACS, CHAdeMO, J1772, or a raw NREL code (J1772COMBO, TESLA, CHADEMO). Comma-separate to match any.

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50, 150, 250). 150 and up only match stations with a known wattage.

speed.description: Charging level: dcfc (DC fast), level2 or level1

state.description: State: two-letter abbreviation (CO), name (Colorado) or slug (colorado)

name: search_stations
title: Search charging stations
